content: Singular Vector Canonical Correlation Analysis (SVCCA) is a general method to compare the correlation of two sets of vector representations. SVCCA has been proposed to compare learned representations across language models BIBREF24. Here we adopt SVCCA to measure the linear similarity of two sets of representations in the same multi-BERT from different translated datasets, which are parallel to each other. The results are shown in Fig FIGREF28.
